translation.name: Le'ec Ada' U T'an A Dios A Tumulbene

book.name: FILIPENSES
book.title: Le'ec Ada' a Carta u Tz'iibtaj aj Pablo Ti'ijoo' a Hermano ich Caj Filipos.

content: Tan u tz'iib aj Pablo ti'ijoo' a hermano ich caj Filipos.

Inen aj Pablo in wet'oc aj Timoteojo. Walac ti betic u meyaj a Jesucristojo. Tan ti tz'iibtic a carta ada' ti'ijoo' a hermanojo, le'ec a que'enoo' u yool tu pach a Jesucristo ich caj Filipos. Tan ilic ti tz'iibtic a carta ada' ti'ijoo' u yaj cananil a hermano u yet'ocoo' u yaj anatil.
In c'ati a Dios ti Tat etel a Noochtzil a Jesucristo ca' u yaante'ex. In c'ati ilic ca' u tz'aa' te'ex u jetz'a'anile'ex a wool.
Le'ec aj Pablojo, tan u c'ajsic a Dios yoc'oloo' a hermanojo.
Pues te'i. Le'ec a boon sut walac in c'ajsique'exe, walac ilic in tz'eec a bo'tic ti'i a Dioso.
Le'ec boon sut ti walac in c'ajsic a Dios ta woc'ole'exe, qui' in wool ti tan in c'ajsic.
Qui' in wool u men le'ec ca' a c'ümaje'ex a Cristo y tac leeb, tane'ex ilic a t'it'ic u pectzil a Noochtzil jabix ilic inene.
Le'ec a Dioso, caji u bete' a quich'pan meyaj ichile'ex a cuxtal. Inene, in weel. Le'ec ca' c'ochoc u q'uinil u yila' a sip'il a Jesucristojo, paataji tun u meyaj a Dios ichile'ex a cuxtal.
Toj ca' in wadü' ti baalo' ta woc'ole'ex u men yaj in wu'ye'ex. Quet tan ti c'ümic u qui'il a Dios ca'ax que'enen ti presojil tanil in ye'ic ti ma' tusil u t'an a Dioso. Tan in ye'ic ti jaj.
Le'ec a Dioso, u yeel ti yaj in wu'ye'ex tu jajil u men tz'abi to'on ti yaje'ex ti wu'yi ti bajil u men a Jesucristojo.

Tan in c'ajsic a Dios ta woc'ole'ex ti'i ca' a mas yacunte'exoo' tulacal a maca. Tanile'ex a mas yacunticoo' tulacal a maca, in c'ati ca' a mas eelte'ex tulacal a ba'al, y ca' a laj eelte'ex tuba que'en a qui' a ma' qui'.
Ti baalo'o, jede'eque'ex a paatal a yeete'ex a mas tojo. Le'ec ca' c'ochoc u q'uinil u yudel a Cristojo, toje'ex tun a na'at, y ma' yane'ex a sip'il.
Ti baalo'o, yan ti yaab a c'u' a toj a tane'ex a betic a jujun tuule'ex u men a Jesucristojo, mentücü, bel u ca'a aalbül u qui'il a Dioso.
Cuxa'anen jadi' ti'i in betical c'u' u c'ati a Cristojo.
Pues te'i. Hermanoje'ex, in c'ati cuchi ca' a wu'ye'ex u tojil. Tan u t'iit'il u pectzil a Dios ti mas yaab u men c'u' a tan u manül tene.
Eeltabi u men tulacaloo' a soldado y tulacaloo' ulaac' a mac ti que'enen ti presojil yoc'lal a Cristojo.
Yaaboo' a hermano a chichajoo' u yool u tz'oques a Noochtzil u men que'enen ti presojil. Chen u men abe'e, mas yanajoo' u muc' u t'an u yadoo' u t'an a Dioso. Ma' ca' saacoo'i.
U menoo' u xüc-oolil, yanoo' a tanoo' u yadic u pectzil a Cristo chen ti'i u mansicalenoo'. Yanoo' ulaac' a tojoo' u na'at ti tanoo' u yadic u pectzil a Cristojo.
Le'ecoo' a xüc-ooloo'o, chen u c'atoo' ca' aalbüc ti mas pataloo'. Chen pachoo' u yool tanoo' u yadic u pectzil a Cristo ti'i ca' u tz'aa'oo' ten ti mas yaj in wool ti que'enen ti presojil.
Le'ecoo' a toj u na'ata, yaj u yubo'on, mentücü, tanoo' u yadic u pectzil a Cristojo. U yeeloo' ti que'enen wa'ye' ti'i ca' in yee' ti ma' tus u t'an a Dioso.

¿C'u' a quin wadü'? Ca'ax tanoo' u yadic tulacaloo' u yool a tojoo' u yoolo, ca'ax tanoo' u yadic chen pachoo' u yool a tanoo' u xüc-oolili, tan u yubajbül u pectzil a Cristojo. Qui' in wool. Ma' jadi' abe'e. Ma' tu manül u qui'il in wool.
In weel ti bel u ca'a ti joc'ol ti qui' ten u men tane'ex a c'ajsic a Dios tin woc'ol etel u men tan u yaaantiquen u Püsüc'al a Dioso
Ma' in c'ati ca' joc'oc ten ti suductzil. In c'ati cuchi ti chich in wool. Ti baalo'o, bel u ca'a aalbül u qui'il a Cristo yoc'lal c'u' a tan in wadic y tan in betic wa ich cuxtal wa ich quimil.
Le'ec in cuxtal inene, chen ti'i in betical c'u' u c'ati a Cristojo. Ca' quimiquene, mas qui' ten.
C'u' betiqui, ti cuxa'anen wa'ye'e, tan u mas tz'a'cül a qui'il u men in meyaj. Ma' eela'an c'u' a mas qui' ca' in yeete, wa cuxtal wa quimil.
Top in c'ati ich ca' xeel. In c'ati cuchi quimil yoc'ol in jan c'ochol ti cuntal etel a Cristojo. Mas qui' ten abe'e.
C'u' betiqui, mas c'abeet ti cuxa'anen wa'ye' in waante'ex.
In weel ti mas c'abeet abe'e, mentücü, in weel ilic ti bel in ca'a ti cuntal wa'ye' in waante'ex tulacale'ex. Bel in quin waante'ex ca' a mas tz'ocse'ex a Dioso, y ca' a mas c'üme'ex a qui'-oolala.
Ti baalo'o, le'ec ca' c'ochoquen ta wetele'ex tucaye'ili, yantal u ca'a te'ex biqui ca' a wade'ex u qui'il a Jesucristo ti yaab tin woc'lal.

Ca'ax c'ochoquen ca'ax ma'a, bete'ex jadi' c'u' a qui' u betabül u menoo' a hermanojo, le'ec a walacoo' u tz'ocsic u pectzil a Cristojo. Ti baalo' jede'ec in wu'yic ti chiche'ex a wool ti quet. Jumbele'ex a tucul ti tane'ex a wadic u pectzil a Cristojo.

Ti baalo'o, ma' tane'ex a saactal ti'ijoo' a mac a ma' qui'oo' tu xiquin u pectzil a Cristojo. Le'ec ti ma' tane'ex a saactal, chica'an cuchi ti'ijoo' ti bel u ca'a tz'abüloo' u sip'il, y bele'ex a ca'a sa'albül u men a Dioso.
Ma' jadi' tz'abi te'ex a qui'il ada'a, le'ec ca' a tz'ocse'ex a Cristojo. Tz'abi ilic te'ex ca' a c'üme'ex a yaj yoc'lal a Cristojo.
Biq'uin ado'o, a wilaje'ex ca' in c'ümaj a yaj yoc'lal a Cristojo. Aleebe tane'ex a wu'yic ti tan to in c'ümic a yaj a jabix abe'e. Tane'ex ilic a c'ümic abe'e.
